title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 学生のうちに留学がしたくて、忙しいアルバイトや語学の資格試験を<u>乗り越えて</u>きた。いよいよお金も貯まり、留学が現実味を<u>帯びて</u>きた。外国での生活が<u>待ち遠しくて</u>たまらない。
english_translation: I wanted to study abroad while I was still a student, so I overcame language certification exams and took busy part-time jobs. Now that I have saved up enough money, studying abroad is taking on a sense of reality. It's my long-awaited dream to live in another country, and I can't wait.
